_about: Hand changes applied on top of out/*.json by tools/convert_routes.py, per guide, in order. 'replace_qid' {from, to} fixes a wrong quest ID on every step of that quest in the guide. 'set_zone' {from, to} relabels the guide's coordinates. 'insert' {step fields} adds a step right after 'after'. Other entries find one step by 'step' {action, qid} or {action, title, nth}: 'after' moves it right after that step; 'note', 'xp' (percent into the step's level:N) and 'dungeon' set those fields; 'optional': true marks it skippable. Per route, '_dungeon_quests' {dungeon: [quest IDs]} tags every step of those quests. 'alt': <dungeon> on a step shows it only while that dungeon is turned off. 'why' is for people reading this file.
